'''Immune implants''' were a type of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] designed to provide immunity to almost all known diseases for its user in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
